subject: Vendor onboarding: privacy checklist & PO steps for Brightline Health
messages:
From: María Soria <maria.soria@rivervend.com>
To: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Intro + onboarding packet for Brightline Health

Hi Sean,

Thanks again for the intro call this morning. As discussed, I attached our completed onboarding worksheet and a current list of subprocessors. We also included our SOC 2 report from last year. A few items we want to confirm so Brightline can move to PO: 

- Does Redwood require a signed DPA prior to issuing a PO, or is a PO with a pending DPA acceptable?
- Brightline asked about data retention defaults: our typical retention for logs is 90 days; is that compatible with your standard retention classes?
- We noted in the procurement questionnaire that Brightline requests access to an exportable audit log. Can you confirm the format and delivery cadence?

Attached: Brightline_Onboarding_Form_v1.xlsx, Rivervend_Subprocessors_2026.csv, Rivervend_SOC2_Report_2025.pdf

Happy to jump on a short call to walk through.

Best,
María Soria
Head of Partnerships, Rivervend
+m: (415) 555-0172

From: sean_gallagher@redwood.com
To: María Soria <maria.soria@rivervend.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, hannah_schmitt@redwood.com
Date: 2026-08-22T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intro + onboarding packet for Brightline Health

Thanks María — received and appreciate the quick turnaround. A few quick clarifications from our side: 

- DPA: For enterprise customers we generally require an executed DPA before any production traffic; procurement can issue a non-production PO earlier for integration work if Brightline prefers.
- Retention: 90 days for logs aligns with our default for trial/pooled environments. For dedicated/contracted customers we can set a retention class in the contract (30/90/365) — Laura, can you confirm standard clause language?
- Audit logs: we provide exportable audit logs in JSONL on a weekly cadence by default; we also support S3 delivery. Hannah, please confirm whether we can do daily exports for Brightline if they request it.

Could you also confirm whether Brightline needs the list of subprocessors redlined into the DPA or if a separate subprocessor schedule is acceptable? That will affect how we prepare the DPA.

Next steps I propose: 
1) Laura to draft the DPA template/retention options and flag any Brightline-specific edits.
2) Hannah to confirm audit log delivery cadence and add notes for procurement.
3) María to confirm whether Brightline will sign DPA before PO or accept a PO with DPA signing on the contract path.

I can host a 30-minute alignment call this afternoon if helpful — 3pm PT works for me.

Cheers,
Sean Gallagher
Senior Manager, Strategic Procurement Ops
Redwood Inference
+1 (628) 555-0133

Hi Sean, thanks — Brightline procurement confirms they prefer an executed DPA before any PO for production access. They may be willing to issue a dev PO for the integration work but would like the DPA signed within 2 business days after the dev PO is issued.

Regarding subprocessors, Brightline prefers a separate subprocessor schedule attached to the DPA rather than in-line redlines. SOC2 report looks acceptable; they asked whether Rivervend rotates keys through an HSM and what encryption in transit guarantees are in place.

We can do a quick call at 3pm PT to iron out details — procurement@brightlinehealth.com will join.

Best,
María
Head of Partnerships, Rivervend

Thanks all — quick recap and owners after our 3pm PT sync: 

- DPA: Redwood will provide the standard enterprise DPA with an attachable subprocessor schedule. Laura to open the DPA draft in DocuSign and include the 30/90/365 retention options. (Owner: laura_bennett)
- Subprocessors: Rivervend provided CSV; Laura to convert to schedule format and Hannah to check for any disallowed subprocessors per Brightline policy. (Owners: laura_bennett, hannah_schmitt)
- Encryption & Keys: Rivervend to confirm HSM rotations and TLS version in writing. María to send a short crypto FAQ by EOD tomorrow. (Owner: Maria)
- Audit logs: Redwood can offer weekly JSONL exports to an S3 bucket by default; Brightline requested a daily export for the integration phase — Hannah to confirm feasibility and cost impact. (Owner: hannah_schmitt)
- PO path: Brightline procurement said they will not issue a production PO until DPA is executed; they are comfortable issuing a dev PO for integration. Sean will follow up with procurement contact to request the dev PO once DPA draft is in DocuSign. (Owner: sean_gallagher)
